claim: Patchline ships a partner certification program with conformance tests and a public registry of passers. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the partner certification claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make partner-certification-program-gate`.
